name: simple_calendar_pro_list_events
intent: List event titles for a date in Simple Calendar Pro
description: Opens Simple Calendar Pro, selects the requested date, and returns the titles of any events scheduled on that date.
patterns: Do I have any events on this date
What events do I have on a date
List my events for a day

inputs.name: event_date
inputs.description: The date to check for events

outputs.name: event_titles
outputs.example: Game night, Product demo, Date night
